observation.command:
echo "=== root redirect target ==="; curl -sS -D - -o /dev/null http://localhost:3000 | grep -i "^location"
echo "=== follow redirect ==="; curl -sSL -o /tmp/follow.html -w "FINAL_URL=%{url_effective} HTTP_CODE=%{http_code}\n" http://localhost:3000
grep -o '<title>[^<]*</title>' /tmp/follow.html
echo "=== vite asset references in page ==="; grep -oE 'src="[^"]*"|href="[^"]*\.css[^"]*"' /tmp/follow.html | head
echo "=== fetch a vite asset ==="
ASSET=$(grep -oE 'src="[^"]*vite[^"]*"' /tmp/follow.html | head -1 | sed 's/src="//;s/"//'); echo "asset=$ASSET"
curl -sS -o /dev/null -w "HTTP_CODE=%{http_code} size=%{size_download}\n" "http://localhost:3000$ASSET"
